producer: hsdtel.contract.export_trial from HSD.MoveDiag v0.2 frames + MOVE-TRACE usercmds

timing.sampling: one row per client script frame (WaitFrame) that simulated at least one usercmd
timing.cmd_association: usercmds whose MOVE-TRACE wall time is at or before the frame's; post-move origin equals the frame origin in 702/702 steps

step_semantics: inputs held during the step; state sampled after the step

initial_state.source: MT pre-move state of the first usercmd of step 0 (o= v= ge= slide= spr= duck=)

terrain.map_source: level-load log line of the session (LOG map)
terrain.standable_source: ground flag at trial start (ge= / IsOnGround); null = not on ground or unknown
terrain.ground_normal_source: not recorded: neither MOVE-TRACE nor HSD.MoveDiag prints a surface normal
terrain.course_note: M3 test field z 294.92; schedule e8_hop350_d3 @120 fps; Gibraltar pinned; empty-handed

provenance.dt: drv (difference of observed Time(); frames without a usercmd are merged into the next step)
provenance.cmd: obs MOVE-TRACE cmd= of the last usercmd logged at or before the frame (wall clock)
provenance.n_cmds: drv (count of MOVE-TRACE lines assigned to the frame)
provenance.in_sprint: obs MOVE-TRACE b= sprint bit (1<<15 in this build; see schema.BUTTON_BITS) of the step's last usercmd
provenance.pressed: drv (MOVE-TRACE b= bits and fwd=/sd= signs, per usercmd, against the previous usercmd)

t.meaning: time at the end of the step (trial-relative, starts near 0)

cmd.meaning: usercmd command_number of the last command simulated in the step

n_cmds.meaning: number of usercmds logged in the step; cmd - previous cmd must equal it

in_fwd.meaning: forward input -1..1 applied during the step

in_right.meaning: right input -1..1 applied during the step

in_yaw.meaning: view yaw during the step (Source convention: + = turn left)

buttons.meaning: usercmd m_nButtons held mask (in_buttons.h bits) of the step's last command

cmd_fwd.meaning: usercmd forwardmove -1..1 of the step's last command

cmd_side.meaning: usercmd sidemove -1..1 (+ = right) of the step's last command

movescale.meaning: m_cachedMoveScale of the step's last usercmd (weapon/ability move-speed factor); optional

maxspeed.meaning: CMoveData maxspeed of the step's last usercmd; optional

pressed.meaning: '|'-joined inputs that went down during the step: button names, AX_FWD/AX_BACK/AX_RIGHT/AX_LEFT

released.meaning: '|'-joined inputs that went up during the step (same names)

events.meaning: '|'-joined events detected at this step: TAKEOFF, LAND, SLIDE_START, SLIDE_END
